limits: No vehicle or ARM64 OEM process execution; full installer preparation on an OEM system image remains untested.
Exact firmware, OEM package and operation catalogs are empty. Signing does not enable vehicle controls.
CAN handles qualified terminal short/long events only. Down/up are forwarded; qualification must exclude a competing native action on either edge. Down/up-only gestures remain native.
Overseas account switching and complete account backup/restore are unavailable. The new probe is read-only and does not establish a recovery contract.
Cold boot, sleep/wake, physical telemetry, OEM microphone, passenger displays, freeform layout and native fallback still need exact-device evidence.
Overseas foreground icon highlighting, app catalog/store and split/APKS installation are not implemented.
The Windows certificate is local and not a publicly trusted publisher certificate.
